name: Townhouse in green, friendly and city close area
description: An unique townhouse (build in 1933) famous for it's functional architecture. Three floors with a small private garden. Only 20 minutes to the city and very close to lake Mälaren. Wake up to the sound of birds singing and have your breakfast at the terrace (sunny days you can relax here in the sun which will leave approx around 02:00 pm). The area is very friendly and there's no problem parking your car outside. This is the place for you who appreciate a mixture between city and suburban life.
host_about:
I'm a father of two wonderful girls (16 and 17), living in this beautiful, quiet and safe area just outside the central parts of Stockholm.  

It's a small but nice terrace house with one master bedroom (for two persons) and two rooms (the girl's) on the top floor. Full size modern kitchen and living room at the same floor. In the basement there's a bathroom and and a guest room with a couch (possible to use as an extra bed). A small garden at the backside with a stone terrace with sun from the morning to midday/afternoon (when the weather smiles at you). 

The area is very calm, close to market, shops, bakery, hairdresser, a nice marina restaurant (10 minutes walk from here) and more. Only 2 minutes walk to the closest tram station and aprox 20-25 minutes to the city of Stockholm. The area is also full of green surrounding with parks and the lake Mälaren 4 minutes walking from the door. Very friendly neighbourhood and neighbourhs. It's a place where you can hear the birds and still very close to the city of Stockholm.    

In summertime I use to stay at my country place in the archipelago outside Stockholm. If there is any problem or if you would like to ask something - don't hesitate to call/contact me. 

I will do my very best to make you feel welcome and have a nice stay here in beautiful Ålsten/Bromma.

/Andreas

description: Sunny studioapartment located in a quiet exclusive residential area in central Stockholm. The studio is fully equipped and located on the island Stora Essingen. host_about:
Hello, my name is Susanna Norén, I live in a villa on Stora Essingen in Stockholm with my husband Jonas, our two children, grandmother Eva and our dog Vilma. To live here is like living on the countryside despite the fact that it is actually located quite central. Therefore I get to enjoy both the tranquility of the countryside but also enjoy the convenience of living central. Here I get the best of both worlds.

What I like the most about Stora Essingen is how it’s surrounded by water and the aforementioned tranquility that the island posseses. I like to exploit how close the water is and take my morning dips in the local bathing spot: Oxhålet, which is just a ten-minute walk away from my house!

In my sparetime I like to ride my bicycle and do yoga, but I also very much enjoy taking our dog for walks. The dog and I both like hiking, so it’s not uncommon for us to do so up to several times a year. Other things I like is Sushi, romantic comedies and to read books (preferably a nice detective story or a biografy).

Everyone in my family loves to travel and we all have our different ideas of what makes an ideal vacation, when I travel alone I prefer smaller, more personal living spaces than the luxurious (and expensive) hotels one might come across.

My life’s motto is: ”treat others the way you want to be treated.”

Jag tror på livet och religionen för mig är andligt.
I min tillvaro är det viktigt att må bra och det gör jag om jag ser livet på ett positivt sätt. Tycker inte om att döma, förakta och  girighet är inte mitt motto. Det jag ger får jag tillbaka och det jag får tillbaka tar jag emot med tacksamhet. Jag har två underbara, kloka, vackra, fantastiska barn som jag gärna delar tid och tillvaro med. Jag är ett adoptivbarn som växte upp med fyra äldre bröder tillsammans med mamma, pappa och vår, allas käraste hund, Zita. 
Jag var den enda dottern och den enda adoptivbarnet (från Etiophien) i familjen. Jag startade mitt företag Dans & Musikal med Bettan, bettansmusikal.com 
1999 köpte jag ett vinterbonad fritidshus strax utanför Stockholm. Tomten och det lilla huset var ett fantastiskt ställe att vara på. Stugan ligger strax utanför Stockholm ca 15min med bil. Nära till natur, havet och doften i början på Stockholms skärgård. En idyllisk plats för den som vill leva enkelt men njuta av den fantastiska miljön av lyx.  Låna gärna sommarstuga, med ömhet, njut av naturen och sköt om miljön så att fler kan få vara med att njutas av den. Varmt välkomna!!

name: Twin Room - Stockholm Hostel (No window)
description: Stockholm Hostel is an Airbnb hostel that offers accommodation in private rooms with private shower and toilet. There's also a shared kitchen where guests can cook with other guests. Bed linens and towels are included in the price. In the room, you will also find a hairdryer and hand soap.
host_about:
Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

Here we have fast wi-fi and all our bedrooms are private with ensuite toilet & shower. 
Please note most rooms are without windows,  so make sure you booked the right room. 
As our guest you have free access to a big kitchen where you can cook your own meals together with other guests. 

Kitchen availabilities:
Stove - Yes (2)
Dishwasher - Yes (2)
Cutlery, plates, glasses - Yes
Fridge - Yes 
Freezer - Yes
Microwave - Yes
Oven - No

Supermarkets like Lidl, Willys, ICA is just around the corner as well as restaurants and bars. 
The Galleria Västermalmsgallerian is in the next building with wide variety of stores such as H&M and Joe & the Juice.

In the summer, bring your swimming gear. The canal of where you can rent SUP (StandUpPaddle Boards) or just have a quick dip or swim is only down the street about 1500 meters. 

Please note that this is a semi-automatic facility with smart and simple self check-in. Our staff is always available here in the AirBnb messages, you can reach us for any questions regarding your stay or recommendations of everything Stockholm has to offer or if you simply just wanna say hi :-)

Stockholm Hostel is runned by us, Marius and Nicole with many years of experience from the hotel industry. We love what we are doing and are always trying to help our guests in the best possible way; with anything you might need to make your trip as great as possible or simply to get a good night's sleep. 

Warmest Regards, 
Marius & Nicole
Managers of Stockholm Hostel

name: Vegetariskt retreatrum. Söder om söder, Stockholm.
description:
We are a vegetarian home with only adults who rent out our bright retreat and yoga room to like-minded travelers and vacationers over Christmas and New Year.
Here you will find a harmonious and quiet environment with silence at 10:00 pm.
The rent includes breakfast. More meals can be discussed if needed. There are Pharmacies, Libraries, Pizzerias, hairdressing salons, grocery stores as well as gyms and flea markets. Parking SEK 40/day, bus stop around the corner and eight-minute walk to the subway. It takes twelve minutes to get into town.
host_about:
Jag är konstnär och kreativ i allt jag företar mig. Jag är vegetarian och har arbetat mer än 20 år till och från som vegetarisk kock på kursgårdar och festivaler bland annat.

Andlighet är en självklarhet för mig. Natur, harmoni. Ödmjukhet och kärlek till planeten.

Som värd låter jag dig vara i fred men både umgås och visar runt vid behov. Eller samtalar och svarar på de frågor jag kan och hjälper till med det som behövs.
 Jag ser det här rummet som något av en retreatplats. För ro, meditation, stillhet och eftertanke med närhet till natur. Men även stadspulsen är nära.

name: Quadruple room - No window
host_about:
Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

Here we have fast wi-fi and all our bedrooms are private with ensuite toilet & shower. 
Please note most rooms are without windows,  so make sure you booked the right room. 
As our guest you have free access to a big kitchen where you can cook your own meals together with other guests. 

Kitchen availabilities:
Stove - Yes (2)
Dishwasher - Yes (2)
Cutlery, plates, glasses - Yes
Fridge - Yes 
Freezer - Yes
Microwave - Yes
Oven - No

Supermarkets like Lidl, Willys, ICA is just around the corner as well as restaurants and bars. 
The Galleria Västermalmsgallerian is in the next building with wide variety of stores such as H&M and Joe & the Juice.

In the summer, bring your swimming gear. The canal of where you can rent SUP (StandUpPaddle Boards) or just have a quick dip or swim is only down the street about 1500 meters. 

Please note that this is a semi-automatic facility with smart and simple self check-in. Our staff is always available here in the AirBnb messages, you can reach us for any questions regarding your stay or recommendations of everything Stockholm has to offer or if you simply just wanna say hi :-)

Stockholm Hostel is runned by us, Marius and Nicole with many years of experience from the hotel industry. We love what we are doing and are always trying to help our guests in the best possible way; with anything you might need to make your trip as great as possible or simply to get a good night's sleep. 

Warmest Regards, 
Marius & Nicole
Managers of Stockholm Hostel

description:

host_about:
Dear Airbnb guest,

Stockholm Hostel is a clean, modern comfortable airbnb hostel with 33 rooms with simple standard in the west centre of Stockholm, located at the district Kungsholmen.
From here you can reach most city landmarks by foot within 15-35 minutes and the closest Metro and bus is only a walking distance of 3 minutes away which will take you anywhere in Stockholm. The airport bus-stop is also around the corner at Fridhemsplan station.

Here we have fast wi-fi and all our bedrooms are private with ensuite toilet & shower. 
Please note most rooms are without windows,  so make sure you booked the right room. 
As our guest you have free access to a big kitchen where you can cook your own meals together with other guests. 

Kitchen availabilities:
Stove - Yes (2)
Dishwasher - Yes (2)
Cutlery, plates, glasses - Yes
Fridge - Yes 
Freezer - Yes
Microwave - Yes
Oven - No

Supermarkets like Lidl, Willys, ICA is just around the corner as well as restaurants and bars. 
The Galleria Västermalmsgallerian is in the next building with wide variety of stores such as H&M and Joe & the Juice.

In the summer, bring your swimming gear. The canal of where you can rent SUP (StandUpPaddle Boards) or just have a quick dip or swim is only down the street about 1500 meters. 

Please note that this is a semi-automatic facility with smart and simple self check-in. Our staff is always available here in the AirBnb messages, you can reach us for any questions regarding your stay or recommendations of everything Stockholm has to offer or if you simply just wanna say hi :-)

Stockholm Hostel is runned by us, Marius and Nicole with many years of experience from the hotel industry. We love what we are doing and are always trying to help our guests in the best possible way; with anything you might need to make your trip as great as possible or simply to get a good night's sleep. 

Warmest Regards, 
Marius & Nicole
Managers of Stockholm Hostel

Bright and charming apartment in a classic 20th-century Stockholm building on Kungsholmen. Original paneled doors, crystal chandeliers, and light hardwood floors create a warm, timeless atmosphere. Fully equipped kitchen, cozy bedroom with a double bed and blackout curtains, and a newly renovated bathroom with a rain shower.

You will have access to the entire apartment, the courtyard with benches and a grill, the laundry room, and the sauna.

The City Hall is within walking distance, and the subway (Fridhemsplan) will take you to Gamla Stan in less than 10 minutes.

Hej! 

Jeg hedder Olivia og bor til daglig i Stockholm, Sverige. Jeg elsker at opleve verden og særligt nye kulturer og køkkener. Jeg sørger altid for, at der er pænt og rent, når jeg tager derfra.

De bedste hilsner,
Olivia
